sample_unit: simulated medication history test recordings (2160 data points)

links.outcome: Ambient scribe documentation accuracy and omission errors, video input vs audio-only
links.effect: Vision-enabled scribe achieved 98% accuracy (2114/2,160 data points); video outperformed audio-only (98% vs 81%, P < 0.001), mainly via fewer omissions (10 vs 358 errors).
links.quote: Video input significantly outperformed audio-only processing (98% vs 81%, P < 0.001), primarily through reduced omissions (10 vs 358 errors).

unlisted_practices: Adding visual (video) input to ambient scribes to capture information not spoken aloud, such as medication labels

screen.reason: Empirical study testing a multimodal vision-enabled ambient scribe against an audio-only model on simulated clinical interviews; it evaluates model architecture/modalities rather than an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
